#   - .github/workflows/build-mlx-xcframework.yml
#   - tools/scripts/fetch-mlx-xcframework.sh

# Bump `mlx=` and `mlx-c=` to the desired upstream revisions, then trigger the
# "Build MLX XCFramework" workflow. When the build succeeds and is published as
# a GitHub Release under the tag `mlx-v<release>`, update `release=` and
# `sha256=` below so downstream `fetch-mlx-xcframework.sh` runs can verify an
# exact downloaded artifact. Runtime CI does not depend on those release fields:
# while they are `unpublished`, it source-builds the macOS arm64 slice from the
# `mlx=` and `mlx-c=` pins.

# Upstream commits to build from (full 40-char SHAs).
mlx=ce45c52505c8158ea48d2a54e8caae05efd86bfe
mlx-c=a0b5179b2a34f6441eb78efe39f3b36be757f5a6

# Published release artifact for download-based installs. Leave these as
# `unpublished` until a `mlx-v*` tag has been cut; the local source-build
# fallback only needs the upstream source pins above.
release=unpublished
sha256=unpublished
